title: Chris Sprouse
description: "The STAR WARS movies explode with amazing visuals," observes Chris Sprouse. "My personal favorites are the lightsaber scenes. This card shows one mentioned, but not shown, in RETURN OF THE JEDI." Sprouse's first professional comics work was for the near-future epic HAMMERLOCKE, published by DC Comics, which led to several jobs on LEGION OF SUPER-HEROES stories set in the 30th century. He's also worked on various DC and Marvel Comics super-hero titles, including BATMAN, THE JUSTICE LEAGUE, and X-MEN. Recently, Sprouse returned to the 30th century, illustrating the LEGION spin-off book, LEGIONNAIRES.
